notes: Both articles of בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם are unrepresented, the written *those* answering to the demonstrative pronoun (rules 41, 47).
The substantival article takes *that which* and heads on the pronoun, the adjective keeping *was right* (rules 41, 20).
*his own* goes whole to the suffix, headed on the pronoun (rule 18).
